fee_notes: Standard single restaurant Initial Fee is $50,000, paid upon signing the Franchise Agreement. Under certain circumstances, the fee may be waived or reduced (including for affiliates, existing franchisees purchasing new Restaurants, or other entities), and payment may be accepted in installments interest-free over 1 to 18 months. Multi-unit development fee is $50,000 multiplied by the number of restaurants to be opened, with a credit applied against each subsequent Franchise Agreement Initial Fee at $50,000 per agreement. During fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, Initial Fees collected ranged from $0 to $50,000 for 5 single restaurants. The fee is fully earned when paid and non-refundable.

Initial Franchise Fees. You must pay us an initial franchise fee (currently equal to $50,000) when you sign the Franchise Agreement (the "Initial Fee").
...During our fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, we collected Initial Fees ranging from $0 to $50,000 for 5 single restaurants.
